track.title: Homayun: Sepehr
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on B in Sepehr. The line peaks at E4 (328.7 Hz) at 0:00.2. It closes on F#3, not the tonic (F#3 → E3 → E3 → Gs3 → B3 → F#3).
